name: telegram-lead-outreach
description: Work leads in Telegram: find prospects by topic, keep only those who self-mentioned it, resolve their handle including through shared groups, pitch personalized and grounded in real templates, run a two-step scheduling close, triage follow-ups, and capture everyone in the CRM. Triggers: "find leads for <topic>", "pitch this prospect", "run outreach".
